chosen_on: grouped dev folds, final DIANA out-of-fold probabilities
rule: smallest tau on the 0 to 0.9 grid (step 0.05) whose retained accuracy is at least 0.05 above the no-abstention accuracy; 0 if none reaches that with coverage >= 0.5
caveat: a no-call threshold removes low-confidence errors only; confidently wrong predictions (for example a label absent from training, like birch pitch at confidence 0.64) pass through
